app.mode.title: Canto modi
app.mode.mini.hint: arifa kwenye ukingo wa skrini pekee
app.mini.label: arifa zinazosubiri
app.focus.label: tahadhari katika kuzingatia

lock.hint.locked: Enter nenosiri kuu ili kufungua kazi na madokezo yako.
lock.hint.create: Nenosiri kuu husimba kila kitu ndani ya nchi. Bila hiyo, hakuna kitu kinachoweza kurejeshwa - hata na wewe.
lock.mismatch: manenosiri hayalingani - andika nenosiri sawa katika sehemu zote mbili
onboarding.title: Karibu kwa canto
onboarding.intro: Vault imeundwa. Majukumu, madokezo, ubao wa kunakili, mikutano, kalenda na GitHub/GitLab husalia kwa njia fiche katika eneo lako, kila moja katika kichupo chake.
onboarding.tip.toggle: inaonyesha au kuficha wijeti, kutoka kwa programu yoyote
onboarding.tip.search: hutafuta kazi, madokezo na ubao wa kunakili mara moja
onboarding.tip.help: inaonyesha orodha kamili ya njia za mkato, wakati wowote
settings.autostart: fungua Canto kompyuta inapoanza (moja kwa moja kwenye trei)
settings.autostart.title: Startup
settings.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
settings.search.label: search settings
settings.githubHint: Connect GitHub in the GitHub tab to get these alerts.
settings.backup.title: Hifadhi nakala
settings.backup.hint.middle: faili, ambayo tayari imesimbwa kwa nenosiri kuu. Ili kuihamisha kwa mashine nyingine, tengeneza kuba hapo na
settings.backup.hint.after: na kuagiza. Inaleta miunganisho, haifuti kamwe.
settings.backup.auto: Nakala otomatiki ya kila siku kwenye folda ya programu (10 za mwisho).
settings.backup.merged: chelezo imeunganishwa: kuba ina kazi {tasks} na noti {notes}
settings.password.changedBiometricOff: nenosiri kuu limebadilishwa; washa bayometriki tena ili kutumia nenosiri jipya
settings.password.pending: funga na ufungue Canto ili kumaliza kusasisha faili moja
settings.password.backupsNote: Nakala otomatiki katika chelezo/ badilisha hadi nenosiri jipya. .canto faili zilizohamishwa mapema huhifadhi nenosiri la zamani.
settings.language.title: Lugha
settings.language.translationNote: Lugha mpya hutumia tafsiri za kiotomatiki. Baadhi ya arifa za ujumuishaji na hitilafu za mazingira ya nyuma bado zinaweza kuonekana katika Kiingereza au Kireno.
settings.density.title: Ukubwa wa kiolesura
app.dnd.title: usisumbue hadi {time}; bofya ili kuzima
app.dnd.titleForever: usisumbue hadi kuzima; bofya ili kuzima
settings.dnd.title: Usisumbue
settings.dnd.hint: hunyamazisha arifa za mfumo na mkutano, ukumbusho na arifa za hali
settings.reminders.title: Vikumbusho
settings.fullscreenHold.title: Michezo na skrini nzima
settings.fullscreenHold.label: subiri skrini nzima kuisha kabla ya kuarifu
settings.fullscreenHold.hint: Dirisha ibukizi au arifa juu ya mchezo wa skrini nzima inaweza kuupunguza. Hii ikiwa imewashwa, arifa subiri na zitaonyeshwa unapoondoka. Windows pekee.
settings.reviewAlerts.title: GitHub ukaguzi
settings.reviewAlerts.label: nijulishe ukaguzi wangu unapoombwa
settings.reviewAlerts.hint: Arifa ya Mfumo wa Uendeshaji kwa kila ombi jipya, huangaliwa kila baada ya dakika 5 wakati vault imefunguliwa.
settings.digest.title: Day summary
settings.digest.hint: One alert with the meetings, open tasks, review requests and unread mentions. Anything at zero is left out, and a day with nothing does not alert. It holds for 4 h after the hour: opening Canto in the afternoon does not bring the morning summary.
settings.myPrAlerts.title: GitHub na GitLab arifa
settings.myPrAlerts.ci: niambie wakati CI ya mojawapo ya PRs yangu itashindwa
settings.myPrAlerts.stalled: niambie wakati mojawapo ya PRs yangu haina hakiki
settings.myPrAlerts.mentionsHint: A pop-up with the link to the conversation. On GitHub it is a direct @username mention (team ones are optional, just below); on GitLab, the pending mention to-do.
settings.myPrAlerts.hint: Dirisha ibukizi kwa kila kipochi, inayoangaliwa kila baada ya dakika 5 wakati vault imefunguliwa. Rasimu PRs haihesabiki.
settings.myPrAlerts.reviews: tell me when one of my PRs/MRs is approved or gets changes requested
settings.myPrAlerts.mergeState: tell me when one of my PRs/MRs becomes ready to merge or gets a conflict
settings.myPrAlerts.comments: tell me when one of my PRs/MRs gets a new comment
settings.myPrAlerts.assigned: tell me when something is assigned to me
settings.myPrAlerts.replies: tell me when someone replies in a thread I commented on (GitHub)
settings.myPrAlerts.teamMentionsHint: Needs the read:org scope on the token. On GitLab a group mention already arrives as a mention.
settings.myPrAlerts.ownHint: On GitLab approvals are not shown (only requested changes), merge state and conflicts come from the MR itself, and a failed pipeline becomes the CI alert.
settings.security.title: Usalama
settings.security.biometricNote: Nenosiri kuu limesimbwa kwa njia fiche kwa ufunguo uliofungwa kwenye chipu ya usalama ya kompyuta hii. Unapowasha, Windows inauliza uthibitisho mara mbili: ya pili inathibitisha kwamba kufungua hufanya kazi. Nenosiri bado linafanya kazi na ndiyo njia pekee ya kufungua chelezo kwenye mashine nyingine.
settings.sync.title: Folda iliyosawazishwa
settings.sync.hint: Ielekeze kwenye folda ya Dropbox, OneDrive au Syncthing: kila mabadiliko yanakiliwa hapo, na chochote kinachofika kutoka kwa mashine nyingine huunganishwa kiotomatiki, kwenye kufungua na kila dakika chache.
settings.sync.merged: kuunganishwa: kuba ina kazi {tasks} na noti {notes}
settings.tabs.title: Vichupo vinavyoonekana
settings.tabs.hint: Mipangilio inaonekana kila wakati. Alt+1, Alt+2… fuata mpangilio wa vichupo vinavyoonekana.
settings.window.title: Dirisha
settings.window.hint: Buruta kwa upau wa juu na ubadilishe ukubwa kutoka kingo: nafasi na ukubwa huhifadhiwa.
